title: 验证卷 #9 · 时间标志词定被动/时态 + 不规则分词形式
topic: IELTS 话题语境变式（第九轮·主谓一致已过关，攻下一层：按时间标志词选时态+产出正确动词形式）
goal: 主谓一致已内化。本轮攻两个新暴露的问题：①时间标志词定不了时态——last week/last year/five years ago（已结束）→ 一般过去时；since/so far/over the past decade + 现在仍相关 → 现在完成时；②产出完整谓语时分词形式错（come-come-come, give-gave-given）。被动语态结构已会，本轮重点在'被动+对的时间'。全对即过关。

questions.prompt: The new hospital in this district ____ (build) five years ago, and it serves the whole town now.
questions.explanation: five years ago → 已结束的过去时间点 → 一般过去时；hospital 被建造 → 被动 was built。后半句的 now 只描述现状，不影响前半句时态。

questions.prompt: The headmaster of the school ____ (give) a talk about study skills last week.
questions.explanation: last week → 一般过去时；主动语态，give 的过去式 gave。时间标志词先定好时态，再写动词形式。

questions.prompt: A number of students from the class ____ (take) part in the online competition so far this year.
questions.explanation: so far this year（延续到现在）→ 现在完成时；裸 a number of + 复数名词 → have；take 的过去分词是 taken：have taken。

questions.prompt: The old bridge in the town centre ____ many times over the past decade, and it is still in use today.
questions.explanation: over the past decade + still in use（和现在有关）→ 现在完成时被动 has been repaired。若只说 'It was repaired last year'（已结束、无现在联系）才用一般过去时。

questions.prompt: A large number of the old buildings in the city centre ____ (rebuild) since 2015.
questions.explanation: since 2015（延续到现在）→ 现在完成时；a large number of + 复数名词 → have；buildings 被重建 → 被动，build 的过去分词 built：have been rebuilt。
